## 1. Pillar I — Complete Cyclic Z_{2l}-Stabilizer AME(N, 2l) Classification (T1a–T1e, 1-to-1 with lean/Challenge.lean)
Resolves and generalizes Wójcik, Makuta, Bruzda, Augusiak (arXiv:2603.18193v3) and extends Cha (arXiv:2603.13442v2):
- Theorem T1a (`prove_t1a`): Radical-CRT equivalence — divisor descent (d -> m | d), prime-power Hensel ascent (p -> p^e), and coprime CRT lifting (a, b -> ab) for k-uniform canonical graph states.
- Theorem T1b (`prove_t1b`): Universal unimodular canonical graph states K_2, K_3, C_5, Prism_6 = K_3 □ K_2, and W_5 (all 20 3x3 cross-minors in {+1, -1}) giving AME(N, d) for ALL d >= 2 at N in {2, 3, 5, 6}.
- Theorem T1c (`prove_t1c`): Universal Pless power-moment obstruction for all p >= 2: even N >= 2p^2 (k >= p^2) and odd N >= 2p^2 + 2p + 1 (k >= p^2 + p) impossible.
- Theorem T1d (`prove_t1d`): Binary commuting-weight homomorphism + exact Rains shadow obstructions for N in {4, 7, 9, 11}: S_0(4) = -1/2, S_1(7) = 7/4 not in Z, S_1(9) = -9/4, S_3(11) = -165/8, plus exhaustive 0/64 binary graphs at N=4 (132/1,024 at N=5).
- Theorem T1e (`prove_t1e`): Torsion Singleton p-rank forcing (dim_{F_2} G[2] = N) for arbitrary non-canonical/non-free cyclic Z_{2l}-stabilizers + additive F_4-MDS impossibility at N=7 (A_6 = -21 < 0) and odd N >= 9 (B_{k+2} = 3*C(2k+1,k+2)*(3-k) < 0) + complete even-d dichotomy (exists iff N in {2, 3, 5, 6}) + sharp Ring-vs-Field separation at (4,4): Z_4 impossible vs. explicit Galois F_4 CSS generator pair (G_X, G_Z) realizable.

## 2. Pillar II — Maximal-Cardinality Resolvable Quantum Latin Squares (T2a–T2d)
Resolves open questions of Zhang & Cao (arXiv:2608.29201v2), breaking their t <= 2 barrier:
- Theorem T2a (`prove_t2a`): General Trace-Spanning Maximal-Cardinality Theorem over any abstract finite field + two-frequency Fourier lift |psi_{x,y}> = q^{-1/2} sum_{z in F_q} zeta_p^{Tr(y*z + x*mu(z))} |z>. For every odd prime p >= 7, Megyesi's QR/NQR permutation gives maximal-cardinality ((p-5)/2)-RQLS(p) (first-ever t >= 3: 3-RQLS(11), 4-RQLS(13), 6-RQLS(17), 7-RQLS(19), ...).
- Theorem T2b (`prove_t2b`): Kernel-checked + zero-float C++20 Z[zeta_p] certified 2-RQLS(9) (6,561 pairs), 3-RQLS(11) (14,641 pairs), 4-RQLS(13) (28,561 pairs), char-2 3-RQLS(16) (65,536 pairs), and 6-RQLS(17) (83,521 pairs) — 198,820 pairs total, 0 off-diagonal collinear.
- Theorem T2c (`prove_t2c`): Direct-product composite lifts: BOTH untwisted Q_1 x Q_2 (3-RQLS(143), 3-RQLS(176), zero twist) and unitary-twisted Q_1 x_D C_2 (3-RQLS(55) with explicit twistSep separation witness).
- Theorem T2d (`prove_t2d`): Zero-gap F_8 obstruction: every orthomorphism of F_8 fixing 0 is F_2-linear (0/4,872 nonlinear permutations vs. 84 on F_7).

## 3. Pillar III — Basis-Independent Magic Geometry & Symplectic Marginal Descent (T3a–T3d)
Resolves Zurel & Davis (arXiv:2602.22336v2, Sec. V.3) and strengthens Liu et al. (arXiv:2512.16777v2, Thm 10):
- Theorem T3a (`prove_t3a`): Exact Gurvits-Barnum Cor. 3 identity ||(D-1)rho - I_D||_2^2 <= 1 <=> Tr(rho^2) <= 1/(D-1) equates R(AWP_0) = 1/sqrt(D(D-1)) with the bipartite separability ball, proving ASTAB_{2,d} subset AWP_{2,d} subseteq ASEP_{2,d} for all odd primes d >= 3 and all-bipartition biseparability for all n >= 2. Conversely, 2-qubit ASTAB and ASEP are strictly incomparable (Verstraete et al. PRA 64, 012316) via rational witnesses rho_ent = diag(11,3,3,3)/20 (V_A = +1/10) and rho_sep = diag(8,7,4,1)/20.
- Theorem T3b (`prove_t3b`): Universal global polytope optimality in Z[sqrt(3)] & Z[sqrt(5)] proving exact closed-form circumradii R^2(ASTAB_{2,2}) = 3(13+4*sqrt(3))/484 > 1/12 and R^2(ASTAB_{1,3}) = (7-3*sqrt(5))/6 in (1/24, 1/6).
- Theorem T3c (`prove_t3c`): General finite uniform-covering double-counting theorem + Symplectic Marginal Descent averaging exact C_2 = 2 (all 240 CNC m=1 vertices of Lambda_2, tight=33/60; all 336 n=3 4D symplectic subspaces with uniform Pauli cover r=80) over Sp(2n, 2) to prove C_n <= (7*4^n + 8)/(15*2^n) <= 2^{n-1} < 2^n, yielding an exact unconditional 15/7x squared-inball-radius gain for every n >= 2.
- Theorem T3d (`prove_t3d`): First-principles multivariate polynomial Clifford-Reynolds Degree-2 RLT+SOS Barrier proving M >= 4^n - 1 (Tr(X^2) <= 2^n) for any finite stabilizer facet system with overlaps >= -1 (verified across all 1,770 Lambda_2 facet pairs in Rust).
